component.name: Subnapi
component.summary: Pobieranie i wysyłanie napisów do filmów

description.p: Subnapi automatically downloads subtitles matched to your movie files (by hash, not by file name) from NapiProjekt, OpenSubtitles and Napisy24, and can upload new subtitles or corrections back to NapiProjekt.

Subnapi automatycznie pobiera napisy dopasowane do plików z filmami (po sumie kontrolnej, nie po nazwie pliku) z serwisów NapiProjekt, OpenSubtitles i Napisy24 oraz pozwala wysyłać nowe napisy i poprawki do NapiProjekt.
Subnapi is a Linux-only fork of QNapi, adding NapiProjekt upload/correction support, a napiprojekt: link handler and a Qt6 port.

Says what actually went wrong instead of always answering "no subtitles found": an unreachable server and refused account details are now told apart from an empty result, and NapiProjekt's stated reason for refusing an upload is repeated rather than dropped. Applies a network timeout, so a server that goes quiet no longer holds a request open forever and locks up the application when a dialog is closed. Fixes several ways subtitle files were corrupted while being converted, uses HTTPS throughout, and stops sending the NapiProjekt password to a check that ignores it.

Restores subtitle downloads from OpenSubtitles, which had started saving a VIP advertisement instead of the subtitles, and matches results by release name when no subtitles carry the movie's hash. Fixes encoding auto-detection, which reported every file as UTF-8 and turned Polish characters in windows-1250 subtitles into replacement characters. The NapiProjekt directory scan no longer presents a failed database check as "not in the database".

Ignores subtitle credit lines that do not name an author when uploading to NapiProjekt — download stamps left by subtitle sites, song credits and "przekład" credits — instead of uploading them as the subtitle author.

Detects subtitle authors from more credit lines when uploading to NapiProjekt, and prefers a translator credit over a broadcaster or studio credit. Files crediting "Napisy: ..." were previously uploaded with no author at all.

First Subnapi release. Compared to the original QNapi: NapiProjekt subtitle upload and correction support (GUI dialog, directory scan-and-review batch flow, CLI switches), a napiprojekt: URI scheme handler, desktop notifications, a Qt6 port, and fixes for UTF-16 subtitle processing and encoding detection.
